# ADR 0003: Round once, to the target currency's minor units

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** FX reference rates service

## Context

Converting through an intermediate rounded rate causes double rounding.

## Decision

Compute amount × perEur(to) ÷ perEur(from) in one step and round to Currency.getDefaultFractionDigits() with HALF_EVEN.

## Consequences

Exact, explainable results (JPY has 0 decimals, USD 2).

## Alternatives considered

Rounding the rate first, then the amount.
